name: ec-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Ecuador for 2026, each rule tied to the Ley de Compañías and the Superintendencia de Compañías, Valores y Seguros (SCVS). Covers the six kinds of commercial company, the compañía limitada (2 to 15 partners, capital fully subscribed and at least 50% of each participation paid at formation, balance within 12 months), the sociedad anónima (capital fully subscribed, a quarter paid, may continue with one shareholder), the sociedad por acciones simplificada (one or more founders, no minimum capital, USD 1 shares, cash paid within 24 months, registered with the SCVS by private document, free), name reservation, electronic incorporation with notary, Registro Mercantil and RUC, the annual filing with the SCVS in the first four months, and the SCVS contribution of up to 1 per thousand of assets. Trigger phrases: constituir compañía Ecuador, S.A.S. Ecuador, compañía limitada, sociedad anónima, Superintendencia de Compañías, capital mínimo, constitución elect
